item.title: It was a year ago that I reported the two incidents of damag3d tyres to two different fars due to the missing bollards and signs indicatingbthat the pavement deliberately sticks out into the road., 27th November
item.description:
Since Jan 2026 there have been temporary, freestanding signs indicating that the pavement just out into the road. In windy weather these get blown around. Please could the council sort this hazard out for road users by replacing the temporary road signs with something more permanent. It' s been years now since the original bollards were damaged. Thank you
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 187, Hewlett Road, Battledown, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
